mentions.name: hnsubstacks
mentions.description: A website that filters Hacker News posts to surface links from Substacks and blogs, deployed serverlessly on Cloudflare Workers as a personal toy project.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a personal way to filter Hacker News for Substack and blog posts while exploring a serverless deployment.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made an HN filter for substacks and blogs:
https://hnsubstacks.com/
